findings.evidence: Store permits N Project bindings per pack while target permits one user binding. Exact-identical tuples may converge; divergent versions/manifests must fail closed and preserve prior global snapshot.
findings.root_cause: N Project authorities collapse to one user authority without frozen binding-set CAS and conflict policy

conclusion.summary: Promote only when all verifiable sources share exact identity; otherwise durable conflict requiring explicit reinstall/selection. User promotion and all Project retirement commit atomically.
